# Sri Gokulam Veg Restaurant — Karaikudi Chettinad Heritage

> Sri Gokulam Veg Restaurant (ஸ்ரீ கோகுலம் சைவ உணவகம்) is an authentic Chettinad Sattvic pure vegetarian restaurant located on Mudiyarasan Salai, near Bharat Petroleum Bunk and Thevar Silai in Karaikudi, Tamil Nadu, India. Renowned for traditional wood-pressed oils, pure cow ghee, freshly ground Chettinad spices, and plantain leaf feasts.

## Core Identity & Facts
- **Business Name**: Sri Gokulam Veg Restaurant (Sri Gokulam Pure Veg)
- **Tamil Name**: ஸ்ரீ கோகுலம் சைவ உணவகம்
- **Type**: 100% Pure Vegetarian Restaurant (Sattvic & Chettinad Heritage Cuisine)
- **Founded / Location**: Karaikudi, Sivaganga District, Tamil Nadu, India
- **Cuisine**: Chettinad Vegetarian, Traditional Tamil Nadu Tiffin, Sattvic, South Indian Thali Meals
- **Price Range**: ₹60 - ₹350 (Affordable & Premium Heritage Dining)
- **Dietary Categories**: 100% Pure Vegetarian, Jain-friendly options (no onion/garlic on request), Vegan-friendly options.

## Service Hours
- **Breakfast & Morning Tiffin**: 06:30 AM – 11:30 AM
- **Raja Chettinad Leaf Lunch**: 12:00 PM – 03:45 PM
- **Evening Tiffin & Snacks**: 04:30 PM – 06:45 PM
- **Royal Chettinad Dinner**: 07:00 PM – 10:45 PM
- **Days Open**: Monday to Sunday (Open all 7 days)

## Signature Specialties & Dishes
1. **Raja Chettinad Full Meals**: 14-item royal feast served on traditional plantain leaf with unlimited rice, Chettinad kuzhambu, kootu, poriyal, appalam, rasam, and fresh payasam.
2. **Crispy Ghee Roast Dosa**: Golden-crisp fermented crepe roasted in aromatic pure cow ghee, accompanied by 3 fresh chutneys and Chettinad sambar.
3. **Chettinad Kuzhi Paniyaram**: Traditional cast-iron cooked shallot dumplings served with fiery tomato kara chutney (available in spicy and sweet jaggery variants).
4. **Vazhaipoo (Banana Flower) Vadai**: Crunchy heirloom lentil patties flavored with fresh spices and banana blossom.
5. **Ennai Kathirikai Kuzhambu**: Stuffed baby brinjals simmered in wood-pressed sesame oil and roasted Chettinad spices.
6. **Kumbakonam Degree Filter Coffee**: Authentic South Indian chicory-blended filter coffee brewed in brass dabarah and tumbler with foaming fresh cow milk.

## Amenities & Services
- **Dine-In**: Spacious Ground Floor Family Dining, AC Royal Hall, and Traditional Veranda.
- **Table QR Digital Ordering**: Contactless menu browsing and order dispatch from table smartphones.
- **Online Table Reservation**: Instant slot booking for families, tourists, and VIP parties.
- **Takeaway / Parcel**: Hygienic tamper-proof eco-friendly packaging.
- **Payments Accepted**: UPI (PhonePe, Google Pay, Paytm), Credit/Debit Cards, Cash.
- **Parking**: Dedicated two-wheeler and four-wheeler parking available.
